name: Bruised
desc: Deep contusions. Everything costs a little more.

name: Bleeding
desc: A wound that will not close on its own. Travel worsens it.

on_travel.text: Blood drips along the gangway plates.

name: Burned
desc: Blistered skin, stiff and weeping.

name: Broken Limb
desc: Splinted or not, the bone grinds.

name: Poisoned
desc: Something is working through the blood.

name: Infected
desc: The wound has gone hot and sweet-smelling.

name: Exhausted
desc: Worn past the marrow; fear is doing the walking.

name: Starving
desc: Hunger has moved from the stomach into the judgment.

name: Dying
desc: Without help, soon, this ends one way.

name: Shaken
desc: Hands not quite steady. Voice not quite level.

name: Panicked
desc: Reason has quit the carriage and taken the luggage.

name: Paranoid
desc: Everyone is lying. The walls are listening. Both of these may be true.

name: Dissociated
desc: Watching themselves from a seat two rows back.

name: Obsessed
desc: One question has eaten all the others.

name: Despairing
desc: Believes the train has already won.

name: Fed by the Train
desc: They have eaten what the train serves. Ordinary food now tastes of ash, and the train remembers their flavor.

name: Partially Forgotten
desc: People's eyes slide off them. Records omit them. The engine cannot hear them.

name: Seen by the Engine
desc: Something at the front of the train has taken a personal interest.

name: Echoing
desc: Their words arrive twice, a half-second apart. Not everyone hears both copies say the same thing.

name: Dead but Moving
desc: No pulse, no breath, no warmth. Still walking. The dead may travel forward, never backward.
